entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yooo, this is the bomb! Nothin' like[n]stretchin' your legs in a huge bath!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I can't believe there's a place like[n]this in front of Leblanc... You got[n]it made, man!
Wanna move in?
I live in an attic.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Damn, good idea! Then again... Not sure[n]I'm into the whole attic thing.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, but... It's kinda cool, y'know? Like[n]a secret lair! But you're right, I dunno if[n]I'd really wanna live up there.

entries.speaker: Ryuji

The bath is warming me up...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It has been quite some time since I last[n]indulged in a warm bath. I had nearly[n]forgotten how wondrous it feels!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Do you get to soak up this paradise[n]every day...? I am green with envy!
Calm down.
You're going to overheat.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Y-You're right, I apologize... If I'm not[n]careful, I'll succumb to lightheadedness.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You're right, I am beginning to feel a tad[n]lightheaded... I shall be careful. Thank[n]you.
